description: A decorated textile, often worked with raised metal stitches, applied as a book cover. Thicker velvets and woven cloths are glued down directly, while delicate fabrics are attached only at the turn-ins to keep adhesive from showing through.
name: embroidered material

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1901), Chapter XIII, p.173. Internet Archive.
